metadata.name: Core Nexus Dual Core 1080p
metadata.description: A reliable 1080p SDR build for low-end and budget hardware. Powered by TorBox and Real-Debrid in tandem — TorBox handles Usenet and uncached traffic, Real-Debrid serves cached streams only. Targets 1080p and 720p only — 4K, 1440p, and HDR content are excluded. Blocks BluRay, Remux, and lossless audio to ensure broad playback compatibility. File range 1 GB–60 GB, 1080p streams capped at 25 GB. Tamtaro SEL stack with live-synced ESEs, PSEs, and regex. Expanded RD Infringing File Scrub covering the full May 2026 keyword blocklist. Designed for phones, tablets, budget Android TV boxes, and Fire TV Sticks.
metadata.author: Branding_Brevity
